# MindDividend Shield

> A multilingual, safety-first first check for suspicious messages and practical guides for common online scams.

MindDividend Shield helps people pause before clicking, paying, replying, sharing a code, or giving remote access. It is a first-pass signal, not a guarantee and not a replacement for a bank, platform, law-enforcement agency, or qualified professional.

## Primary resources

- [MindDividend Shield](https://minddividend-shield.joe303262000.chatgpt.site/): live interactive first-pass checker for a redacted suspicious message; never paste passwords, payment details, verification codes, or identity documents.
- [Start here](https://alphaengineerai.com/start.html): multilingual entry point, safety rule, and public sharing links.
- [Free global scam checkers in 13 languages](https://alphaengineerai.com/guide-directory.html): browse language hubs, message checkers, recovery checklists, common-scam pattern guides, and official reporting routes.
- [Is this text a scam?](https://alphaengineerai.com/is-this-text-a-scam.html): psychology-aware first-check guide to urgency, codes, payment requests, impersonation, unsafe links, and safer next steps.
- [Global online scam message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/global-online-scam-checker.html): focused entry point with safe-use rules, common signals, FAQs, and thirteen-language links including Italian.
- [Community scam-awareness toolkit](https://alphaengineerai.com/community-scam-awareness-toolkit.html): a free, shareable five-step reminder for families, educators, creators, and community groups.
- [Scam safety resource for organizations](https://alphaengineerai.com/scam-safety-resource-for-organizations.html): a public description and citation guide for organizations, educators, creators, moderators, and community leaders.
- [Global share kit](https://alphaengineerai.com/global-share-kit.html): a public page with copy-ready messages, privacy rules, share links, and 13-language entry points.
- [Global publisher kit](https://alphaengineerai.com/global-publisher-kit.html): copy-ready descriptions, canonical links, privacy rules, and an embeddable public badge for publishers, NGOs, educators, and community hubs.
- [Copy-ready public safety reminder](https://gist.github.com/youfuxu/cc352fdf5dfb8fc00e9173a8f3e93e5f): a plain-text checklist that communities can share without exposing private messages or live suspicious links.
- [Global share kit](https://github.com/youfuxu/alphaengineerai-landing/blob/main/global-share-kit.md): copy-ready short messages, privacy rules, and direct entry points in 13 languages.
- [Free Online Scam Message Checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/minddividend-shield.html): a free global first check for suspicious texts, emails, social DMs, bank alerts, jobs, and payment requests before you act.
- [About MindDividend Shield](https://alphaengineerai.com/about-minddividend-shield.html): public methodology, privacy rules, source approach, multilingual scope, and limits of the first-pass checker.
- [Website scam checker guide](https://alphaengineerai.com/website-scam-checker.html): a safety-first checklist for suspicious sites, stores, payment pages, and links; includes Google Safe Browsing and official next steps without claiming that any green result is a guarantee.
- [Suspicious link checker guide](https://alphaengineerai.com/suspicious-link-checker.html): inspect a link without opening it, verify the real domain through an independent route, protect private session links, and choose safer next steps before clicking or paying.
- [Phone scam checker guide](https://alphaengineerai.com/suspicious-call-checker.html): check suspicious calls, spoofed caller ID, urgent requests, verification-code demands, payment pressure, and safer official call-backs.
- [Public discussion: suspicious call warning signs](https://github.com/youfuxu/alphaengineerai-landing/discussions/44): share general call-scam patterns without posting phone numbers, recordings, codes, or private details.
- [Public discussion: suspicious link safety](https://github.com/youfuxu/alphaengineerai-landing/discussions/37): a shareable explanation of the link-safety checklist; never post private messages, session URLs, passwords, or verification codes.
- [Public discussion: how to report an online scam safely across countries](https://github.com/youfuxu/alphaengineerai-landing/discussions/71): verification, redacted evidence, official reporting, and recovery-scam guidance without posting private data.
- [Online shopping scam checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/online-shopping-scam-checker.html): checks unfamiliar stores and marketplace sellers for low-price pressure, copied identity, payment risks, delivery promises, and refund uncertainty.
- [Scam message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/scam-message-checker.html): English guide for suspicious texts, email, DMs, bank alerts, jobs, and payments.
- [Fake bank text message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/fake-bank-text-message.html): warning signs and safe verification steps for suspicious bank alerts before signing in or sharing a code.
- [Romance scam checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/romance-scam-checker.html): a calm guide to rapid intimacy, secrecy, money requests, crypto pitches, and intimate-image pressure.
- [Recovery scam checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/recovery-scam-checker.html): check unexpected refund, tracing, legal, bank, or recovery-agent messages after an earlier loss; never pay an upfront recovery fee.
- [QR code scam checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/qr-code-scam-checker.html): inspect unexpected QR codes in texts, emails, packages, parking signs, invoices, and payment requests before scanning or paying.
- [WhatsApp scam message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/whatsapp-scam-message-checker.html): checks verification-code requests, family emergencies, fake support, groups, and payment links.
- [Phishing email checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/phishing-email-checker.html): checks sender identity, login links, attachments, invoices, payment requests, and urgency.
- [Online job scam checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/online-job-scam-checker.html): checks upfront fees, crypto tasks, reshipping requests, fake recruiters, and pressure to move off-platform.
- [Fake package delivery message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/fake-package-delivery-text.html): checks shipping alerts, customs-fee requests, delivery links, and demands for payment or personal details.
- [AI and deepfake scam checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/ai-deepfake-scam-checker.html): checks voice clones, realistic videos, fake executives, and family-emergency impersonation before payment or disclosure.
- [Investment scam checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/investment-scam-checker.html): checks guaranteed returns, fake trading apps, social-media tips, crypto deposits, romance-investment pressure, and withdrawal fees.
- [Common online scams](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams.html): English overview of bank, delivery, job, investment, marketplace, impersonation, and tech-support scams.
- [What to do if you clicked a scam link](https://alphaengineerai.com/what-to-do-if-you-clicked-a-scam-link.html): calm response checklist after a click.
- [點擊詐騙連結後怎麼辦？立即處理清單（繁體中文）](https://alphaengineerai.com/what-to-do-after-clicking-scam-link-zh-hant.html): 點擊可疑連結後停止輸入，保護密碼、付款、裝置與證據的繁體中文清單。
- [Cosa fare dopo aver cliccato un link truffa](https://alphaengineerai.com/cosa-fare-dopo-aver-cliccato-link-truffa.html): checklist italiana per proteggere account, pagamenti e dispositivo dopo un clic sospetto.
- [Qué hacer si hiciste clic en un enlace de estafa](https://alphaengineerai.com/que-hacer-si-hiciste-clic-en-un-enlace-de-estafa.html): lista tranquila en español para proteger cuentas, pagos y dispositivos.
- [O que fazer se clicou num link de golpe](https://alphaengineerai.com/o-que-fazer-se-clicou-num-link-de-golpe.html): lista calma em português para proteger contas, pagamentos e dispositivos.
- [Que faire après avoir cliqué sur un lien d'arnaque](https://alphaengineerai.com/que-faire-apres-avoir-clique-lien-arnaque.html): liste calme en français pour protéger comptes, paiements et appareils.

## Common scam pattern guides

- [Estafas online comunes（Español）](https://alphaengineerai.com/estafas-online-comunes.html): patrones de banca, entregas, empleo, inversión, marketplaces y suplantación.
- [Golpes online comuns（Português）](https://alphaengineerai.com/golpes-online-comuns.html): padrões de banco, entregas, emprego, investimento e suporte falso.
- [Arnaques en ligne courantes（Français）](https://alphaengineerai.com/arnaques-en-ligne-courantes.html): signaux liés aux banques, livraisons, emploi, investissement et faux support.
- [Häufige Online-Betrugsmaschen（Deutsch）](https://alphaengineerai.com/online-betrugsmaschen.html): Warnzeichen bei Bank, Lieferung, Job, Investition und Identitätsvortäuschung.
- [आम ऑनलाइन ठगी（हिन्दी）](https://alphaengineerai.com/online-scam-guide-hi.html): बैंक, डिलीवरी, नौकरी, निवेश और नकली सहायता के सामान्य तरीके।
- [أشكال الاحتيال الشائعة（العربية）](https://alphaengineerai.com/online-scam-guide-ar.html): علامات التحذير في البنوك والتوصيل والعمل والاستثمار والدعم المزيف.
- [English common online scams](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams.html): bank, delivery, job, investment, marketplace, impersonation, and tech-support patterns.
- [常見網路詐騙有哪些？繁體中文辨識指南](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams-zh-hant.html): 點擊、付款或回覆前的常見故事、施壓模式與安全查證步驟。
- [Penipuan online umum（Bahasa Indonesia）](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams-id.html): tanda bahaya bank, pengiriman, pekerjaan, investasi, marketplace, dan akun palsu.
- [Các trò lừa đảo trực tuyến phổ biến（Tiếng Việt）](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams-vi.html): dấu hiệu trong ngân hàng, giao hàng, việc làm, đầu tư và hỗ trợ giả.
- [よくあるネット詐欺（日本語）](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams-ja.html): 急がせるパターンをクリック・送金・返信の前に確認するガイド。
- [흔한 온라인 사기（한국어）](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams-ko.html): 은행, 배송, 일자리, 투자, 거래와 계정 사칭의 위험 신호。
- [Truffe online comuni（Italiano）](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams-it.html): segnali di banca, consegne, lavoro, investimenti, marketplace e falso supporto.

## Safe interpretation

Never provide passwords, payment details, verification codes, identity documents, or private addresses to a public checker. Redact a message before review. A suspicious-looking message should be verified through the official app, website, or a known contact route.
